name: soft-key-door-goal
task: Pick up the key, then open the door, and then, ideally, walk onto the goal.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: the task commands 'Pick up the key' unconditionally, but no clause makes has_key happen — Precedence(has_key, door_open) is only a rule, and the hard Existence(door_open) does not force has_key to ever occur (the machine is reachable to u2 by never picking up the key). Add a hard Existence(has_key). Also, 'ideally' scopes only 'walk onto the goal', which the soft Existence(at_goal) correctly captures; keep the hard Precedence clauses and the hard Existence(door_open).

NO CHANGES NEEDED: Existence(has_key) hard commands picking up the key; Precedence(has_key, door_open) hard with Existence(door_open) hard gives the ordered 'open the door' step and forces has_key; Precedence(door_open, at_goal) hard records 'then walk onto the goal'; and the soft Existence(at_goal) correctly captures the preference cue 'ideally' without forcing it.

texts: The agent picks up the key (has_key) at least once.
Before (door_open) happens, (has_key) must have already happened.
The door is opened (door_open) at least once.
Before (at_goal) happens, (door_open) must have already happened.
Ideally the agent reaches the goal (at_goal).
